author: GameTrailers
description:
"Obsession breeds demons." Here's your look at the JIAOHUN trailer for this upcoming cinematic first-person psychological horror game set in a small Chinese town during the 1990s. In JIAOHUN, you will gradually uncover the mystery behind the downfall of Fairy Town. JIAOHUN will be available on PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027.

The restless souls entangled with your karma follow you like shadows. What awaits you is punishment among the mountains of blades and forests of thorns, yet a voice whispers to you: "Only I can help you."
title: JIAOHUN - Official Trailer (Chinese Language) | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026 (Chinese Language)

author: GameTrailers
description:
Sunny and Buddy are in this together. Sunny and his fiercely loyal canine companion share an unbreakable bond as they fight side-by-side to survive the apocalypse. Together, they’ll have to make their way across the zombie-infested, sun-baked state of Arizona. Take on hordes of zombies, play solo or team up with friends, and see how long you can survive. In multiplayer co-op, you can even play as Buddy and experience the apocalypse from a whole new perspective.

Arizona Sunshine launches January 21, 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Arizona Sunshine - Official Meet Your New Best Friend Release Date Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Sker: The Bleeding Veil, an upcoming first-person horror adventure game developed by Stormind Games and Wales Interactive. Players will embark on this brand-new sequel with new locations to explore, enemies to face, and secrets to make sense of. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil - Official Reveal Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the 'Remastering a Legend' Featurette for The Wolf Among Us Remastered, a modern version of the iconic narrative-driven adventure game developed by Telltale Games. Players can get a look at the new additions to the game, with improved lighting, updated animation, refined environments, the all-new Noir Mode, never-before-seen playable deleted scenes, behind-the-scenes video interviews, and more. The Wolf Among Us Remastered is launching on October 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered - Official 'Remastering a Legend' Featurette

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2, a first-person action retro shooter developed by Auroch Digital. Players will fight in the name of the Emperor with an array or weapons and plenty of enemies to take on. Join the Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath to harness the power of devastating abilities in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at the characters, story, and more from Tales of Eternia Remastered in this latest trailer for the upcoming RPG remaster. Tales of Eternia Remastered features updated visuals, dynamic battles, unforgettable characters, and an epic journey to save two intertwined worlds. Tales of Eternia Remastered will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on October 16, 2026.
title: Tales of Eternia Remastered - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at Season 2 of NBA 2K27, the latest in the basketball simulation franchise developed by Visual Concepts. Players can get the rundown on the new GOAT builds for Season 2, offering more ways to play and dominate on the court. Season 2 for NBA 2K27 is launching on October 16 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: NBA 2K27 - Official Season 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at Season 2 for Wardogs, a first-person action shooter developed by Bulkhead. Players can soon check out the new season with new weapons, vehicles, buildables, and more to wage war on the battlefield. Season 2 is also fitted with improvements to combat, progression, and more to enhance the experience, with plenty more on the horizon. Wardogs Season 2 is launching on October 15 for PC (Steam).
title: Wardogs - Official Season 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Vincit, a stylized action first-person shooter developed by Cowboy & Clown Games. Players will shoot elementally infused ammo to create chain reactions with Fire, Water, Electricity, Healing, Nails, and more to dish out. Fight with the striking manga art style in Vincit, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Vincit - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Among the Trolls, a first-person narrative-adventure game developed by Avantgarden SRL. Players will explore the Finnish forest to survive and seek out the secrets that remain. Craft, interact with the ancient shamanistic magic, and more in Among the Trolls, available now on PC (Steam).
title: Among the Trolls - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Sesame Street: Friends and Fun, an educational adventure game developed by Infinigon Games. Players will embark on an epic ride full of fun to explore the neighborhood, featuring Elmo and his Sesame Street friends. Sesame Street: Friends and Fun is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Sesame Street: Friends and Fun - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Harvest Skies: Crop Dusting Simulator in this latest trailer for the upcoming game. Job sim? Flight sim? Co-op for 1–4 players? YES. Take farm jobs with friends, upgrade your hangar and grow a fleet. Mostly chill, with the occasional power-line PANIC. Harvest Skies will be available on PC. You can join the free co-op playtest on Steam if you're interested.
title: Harvest Skies - Official New Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest trailer for Sublustrum, a psychological adventure exploring memory, perception, and the subconscious. The new trailer reveals Nicholas Boulton as the voice of the Professor and showcases new locations, strange machinery, and intricate puzzles built around observation, experimentation, and careful listening.

In Sublustrum, you search for your missing scientist brother while descending into a surreal world where sound, mechanisms, and fragmented memories become part of the mystery.

Sublustrum will be available on PC. An open playtest runs from October 12 to October 25, 2026 on Steam, and you can request access if you're interested. The open playtest features Chapter One.
title: Sublustrum - Official Open Playtest Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Brick of Treat Gameplay Trailer for LEGO Fortnite Odyssey, the hit action creation mode in Fortnite based on LEGO. Players will embark on weekly quests to menace the village in honor of the spooky season. Cause frights in Brick of Treat for LEGO Fortnite Odyssey, available now within Fortnite.
title: LEGO Fortnite Odyssey - Official Brick of Treat Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo launch trailer for Seikyu Let’s Go! Players will rely on each other to navigate the wilderness, keep their van looking swish, and further their careers as budding wildlife photographers. Biomes populated with curious creatures are waiting for you and your hapless group to scramble across. Camp under the stars and swap stories of the day's adventures! Create your own personal yokai, then transform your creaky campervan into a cozy mobile home filled with trinkets and treasures. Seikyu is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now.
title: Seikyu Let’s Go! - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the early access trailer for Near Mint, a new spin on Deckbuilding gameplay, set in a dark fantasy world. Developed by Duper Games, the team behind Day of the Shell, Near Mint flips the deckbuilding combat on its head by allowing you to mix your cards. Each card is torn when you collect it, allowing you to recompose them to create new cards with enhanced effects or entirely new uses!
 
Near Mint launches into Early Access on PC (Steam) on November 11th!
title: Near Mint - Official Early Access Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for the new expansion for Marvel Champions: The Card Game, Fear No Evil!
title: Marvel Champions: The Card Game - Official Fear No Evil Expansion Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for STAR WARS: The Deckbuilding Game - Rebel and Empire Reinforcements! Available now.
title: STAR WARS: The Deckbuilding Game - Official Rebel and Empire Reinforcements Trailer
